Political money counts PAC, business and union contributions to candidates for Village of Saranac Lake offices reported to the State Board of Elections since 2022-10-01. Data center deals and corporate lobbying come from a hand-checked list of news reports and public records. A town with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

Red flags: 2 license-plate cameras are mapped inside Village of Saranac Lake's borders in OpenStreetMap (2 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 2 Flock Safety license-plate cameras are mapped inside Village of Saranac Lake's borders in OpenStreetMap. Flock cameras photograph every passing car and feed a search network shared with police agencies across the country. Who runs each camera is recorded for some; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
